name: Iaijutsu Expert (Combat)
body:
You can unlock the true power of iaijutsu techniques.

Prerequisite(s): Iaijutsu technique class feature

Benefit(s): Select an iaijutsu technique you possess; if that iaijutsu technique would force a creature to making a saving throw, the DC of that saving throw is increased by +2. All other iaijutsu techniques you possess have their DC increased by +1.
